note: Gabon: nationals of the other CEMAC states and Morocco enter without a visa for 90 days, Mauritians and South Africans for 30; everyone else applies for an e-Visa (since 15 June 2015; arriving at Libreville; 1 to 3 months at EUR 70), except Lebanese, who need an entry authorisation besides a visa, and US citizens, to whom visas have been suspended since 1 January 2026 (both taken as a visa). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Gabon
sources.said: According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Gabon, citizens of the following countries do not require a visa to enter Gabon, for visits up to the duration listed below: 90 days Cameroon Central African Republic Republic of Congo Chad Equatorial Guinea Morocco 30 days Mauritius South Africa ... The e-Visa system is usable by citizens of any country that requires a visa to visit Gabon. ... Citizens of Lebanon are specifically required to hold an "Authorisation to enter Gabon" (Autorisation d'entree au Gabon) in addition to a visa in order to enter Gabon. United States - Following the United States visa issuance suspension on Gabonese citizens, on 1 January 2026, Gabon also imposed a reciprocal visa issuance suspension on United States citizens.
